methodology: Actual full MDX reads and source-specific evidence review; no automatic inference from a downloaded source.

pages.title: Martius Flap
pages.scope: Entire original MDX read by the assigned reviewer or root; root independently read entire final revision, tables, references and links. Source-specific scope is recorded separately.
changes: Corrected modern fat-pad anatomy, target/pedicle contradictions and unsupported default side/drain rules.
Corrected VVF/RVF cohort and at-risk SUI denominators, timing and combined success endpoints; removed equivalence and universal morbidity claims.
Replaced the Cochrane protocol as outcome evidence; separated mesh exposure from urinary-tract erosion and selective interposition from routine use.
